title: Shadow and Bone
author: Leigh Bardugo
summary: A mapmaker in an army regiment discovers she has a rare power that could free her country from a dark, monster-filled expanse of shadow. She is swept off to the royal court to train with the elite magicians, among them a charismatic leader.
readIf: you want a young-adult fantasy with a Russian-inspired world, a clear chosen-one arc and a brooding love interest.
skipIf: you want fresh twists on the chosen one, since this is the more conventional start to the series.

pairings.reason: Set in the same world but sharper, funnier and more tightly plotted, so a good next step.
Another young-adult fantasy with a young woman at court, a love triangle and a growing war.
Another story of a girl with unexpected power drawn into a royal court of schemers.
